en.t: Do you still recognize this child?

units.source_text: 我因你去向不明，把他看作你的遗念，正在抚育他呢。”

en.t: Because I did not know where you had gone, I have been raising him as a keepsake of you.

units.source_text: 信中言语非常诚恳周至。

en.t: The words in the letter were extremely sincere and considerate.

units.source_text: 薰大将既已来了如此详明的信，浮舟便无法推诿。

en.t: Since General Kaoru had sent such a detailed letter, Ukifune could no longer make excuses.

units.source_text: 但念此身已经变装，不复是从前的人，突然被那人看到，实在难以为情。

en.t: But when she thought that she had changed her appearance and was no longer the person she had once been, she felt it would be terribly embarrassing to be seen by him all at once.

units.source_text: 因此情绪纷乱，本来愁闷的心更加忧郁了，弄得毫无办法，终于俯伏着哭泣起来。

en.t: Her feelings were thrown into confusion, and her already sorrowful heart grew still more despondent; helpless at last, she bent down and began to weep.

units.source_text: 妹尼僧觉得此人实在奇怪，心甚焦灼，便责问她：“你怎样回复呢？”

en.t: The younger nun thought her behavior truly strange, and in great agitation pressed her, asking, How will you answer?

units.source_text: 浮舟答道：“我心情非常混乱，且请暂缓，不久自当奉复。

en.t: Ukifune replied, My feelings are in great turmoil; please let the matter wait for now, and before long I shall answer properly.

units.source_text: 我回思往事，竟全然记不起来。

en.t: When I think back over the past, I find I cannot remember it at all.
That is why I was so astonished when I read this letter.

units.source_text: 他所谓‘噩梦’不知所指何事，我竟莫名其妙。

en.t: I do not know what he means by a nightmare, and I am utterly bewildered.

units.source_text: 且待我心情稍稍安静之后，或许能够理解此信之意义。

en.t: If I wait until my feelings have calmed a little, perhaps I may be able to understand the meaning of this letter.

units.source_text: 今天还是叫他把信拿回去吧。

en.t: For today, please have him take the letter back with him.

units.source_text: 如果弄错了人，两方都不稳当。”

en.t: If this is a case of mistaken identity, it would be awkward for both sides.

units.source_text: 便把展开的信交还妹尼僧。

en.t: She then handed the opened letter back to the younger nun.

units.source_text: 妹尼僧说：“这真是太难堪了！

en.t: The younger nun said, This is truly unbearable!

units.source_text: 过分失礼，使得我们这样侍奉你的人也不好交代呢！”

en.t: It is far too discourteous, and it leaves even those of us who serve you with no way to explain ourselves.
She then began to grumble on and on.

units.source_text: 浮舟很讨厌她，觉得难于入耳，便把衣袖遮住了脸躺卧着。

en.t: Ukifune found her very tiresome and could hardly bear to listen, so she covered her face with her sleeve and lay down.
